comparison.objective: Crack a walnut in a hand nutcracker and sort kernel from shell.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual opposing squeeze through hinged levers, followed by sorting several pieces.
comparison.success_condition: Contact-force-triggered crack, kernel in bowl, shell on saucer and arms returned; current spec uses 40 N per jaw for 0.1 s.
comparison.reason: Closest fracture-and-sort neighbor, but it tests symmetric quasi-static squeezing of a bulk shell. The candidate uniquely tests coaxial support of a narrow mandrel during a separate hammer strike, off-axis protection of retained coils, and recovery of four millimetre tangs.
